nodes.name: files
nodes.signature: val files = publication.artifacts.associate { val classifier = it.classifier?.takeIf(String::isNotBlank)?.let { value -> "-$value" }.orEmpty() it.file.relativeTo(rootDir).invariantSeparatorsPath to "$coordinate/$base$classifier.${it.extension}" } + mapOf( layout.buildDirectory.file("publications/maven/pom-default.xml").get().asFile.relativeTo(rootDir).invariantSeparatorsPath to "$coordinate/$base.pom", layout.buildDirectory.file("publications/maven/module.json").get().asFile.relativeTo(rootDir).invariantSeparatorsPath to "$coordinate/$base.module", )

nodes.name: constants
nodes.signature: val constants = tasks.register<GenerateModConstants>("generateModConstants") { modId = metadata.modId modPackage = metadata.modPackage outputDirectory = layout.buildDirectory.dir("generated/sources/modConstants") }

nodes.name: dependencies
nodes.signature: val dependencies = listOf( "minecraft" to metadata.minecraftVersionRange.get(), (if (loader == HauyneModLoader.FORGE) "forge" else "neoforge") to metadata.loaderVersionRange.get(), ).joinToString("\n") { (id, range) -> """ [[dependencies.${metadata.modId.get()}]] modId="$id" versionRange="$range" ${if (loader == HauyneModLoader.FORGE) "mandatory=true" else "type=\"required\""} ordering="NONE" side="BOTH" """.trimIndent() }

nodes.name: values
nodes.signature: val values = mapOf( "modId" to metadata.modId.get(), "modName" to metadata.modName.get(), "version" to project.version.toString(), "dependencies" to dependencies, "loaderVersion" to metadata.javaFmlLoaderVersionRange.get(), "license" to metadata.license.get(), )

nodes.name: validateModRelease
nodes.signature: val validateModRelease = tasks.register<ValidateReleaseSettings>("validateModRelease") { required = providers.gradleProperty("modPublishDryRun").map { !it.toBooleanStrict() }.orElse(false) for (key in listOf("curseforgeProjectId", "modrinthProjectId")) { configurationPresent.put( key, providers.gradleProperty(key).map { it.isNotBlank() }.orElse(false), ) } for (key in listOf("CURSEFORGE_TOKEN", "MODRINTH_TOKEN")) { configurationPresent.put( key, providers.environmentVariable(key).map { it.isNotBlank() }.orElse(false), ) } }

nodes.name: validateRelease
nodes.signature: val validateRelease = tasks.register<ValidateReleaseSettings>("validateRelease") { group = "publishing" description = "Validate all publication settings before uploading" required = providers.environmentVariable("CI").map(String::toBooleanStrict).orElse(false) for (key in listOf("R2_ACCESS_KEY", "R2_SECRET_KEY", "R2_ENDPOINT", "CURSEFORGE_TOKEN", "MODRINTH_TOKEN")) { configurationPresent.put(key, providers.environmentVariable(key).map { it.isNotBlank() }.orElse(false)) } for (key in listOf("curseforgeProjectId", "modrinthProjectId")) { configurationPresent.put(key, providers.gradleProperty(key).map { it.isNotBlank() }.orElse(false)) } }
